card.name: Pediatric age ranges after a number
card.fires_on: The word years, or the 'to' or dash joining two ages, right after an age number such as 12 or 10 in pediatric dosing or study text. It marks the unit of an age cutoff or range.

modes.label: Years after age number
modes.description: The word years or Years follows a starting age like 12 in a pediatric group.
modes.example: recommended dosage of azelastine hydrochloride nasal solution in adults and adolescent patients 12<< years>> and older with seasonal allergic rhinitis

modes.label: Range joiner between ages
modes.description: A 'to' or dash links two ages in a range such as 10 to 17 years.

card.plain: It lights up on the age wording in pediatric groups, like the 'years' in '12 years and older' or the 'to' in '10 to 17'.
